name: Velocisaurus
sum: Small Late Cretaceous noasaurid from Argentina with a distinctive foot, about 1.5 m long.
wsnote: Probably about 1.5 m, extrapolated from a tibia 14 cm long (Wikipedia revision 1387574238).
